inputs.name: atomLibrary.root
inputs.description: Repository root used to locate src and compute the selected library path. If src is absent, the workflow returns src/components/atoms; it recognizes only Svelte files with a parseable @harness-atoms declaration whose target contains HtmlButton.svelte.

inputs.name: useAtomLibrary.files
inputs.description: Planned files to transform. When the directory is not src/components/atoms, each entry is shallow-copied and .svelte entries use path and contents for import and declaration rewriting; an empty array is accepted.

inputs.name: useAtomLibrary.directory
inputs.description: Repository-relative atom library directory, typically the path returned by atomLibrary. The exact value src/components/atoms skips rewriting; any other string is used as the replacement directory without checking that it exists.

outputs.name: atomLibrary
outputs.description: Repository-relative path to the single recognized native atom library. It defaults to src/components/atoms when src is absent or no qualifying declaration exists, and fails when more than one distinct qualifying directory is found.

outputs.name: useAtomLibrary
outputs.description: Files returned for generation. If directory is src/components/atoms, the original array is returned; otherwise each file object is shallow-copied and only .svelte contents are rewritten for atom imports and the @harness-atoms marker.

errors.name: ExpectedCliError
errors.description: Thrown by atomLibrary when it finds more than one qualifying native atom library directory; the error message asks to reconcile the shared library before generating UI.
